description: Social Search Across Platforms: one keyword search on Reddit and TikTok, plus X (Twitter) when its key is enabled, at once (choose 1-3), run in parallel. Posts and videos from every platform in one shared schema with text, author, likes, replies, reposts, views, time and URL; platforms_missing names any platform that failed (such a partial answer is charged), next_cursor continues every platform. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.025 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page (asks only the platforms that have a next page).

platforms.description: Comma-separated, 1-3 of x, reddit, tiktok. Default all three.

name: social_search
title: Social search on X, Reddit and TikTok
